etapes.en: A great speech has: a hook, a clear structure (signposting), and a memorable ending. Use the rule of three, rhetorical questions and repetition.

exemples.en: Today I'd like to talk about…
We came, we learned, we succeeded.
exemples.fr: Nous sommes venus, nous avons appris, nous avons réussi.

etapes.en: Example opening: « Good evening, everyone. Imagine a country where every child can read. Tonight, I want to share three ideas that could make this dream real. »

etapes.question: « Rule of three » means…
etapes.explication: Grouping ideas in threes is memorable.

etapes.question: A good hook is…
choix: a question or a surprising fact

etapes.en: Let me wrap up with one final thought
etapes.fr: Permettez-moi de conclure avec une dernière pensée
Je voudrais commencer par une question.
reponses: I'd like to start with a question.
I would like to start with a question.
I'd like to begin with a question.

etapes.en: Thank you all for being here tonight.
choix: Merci à tous d'être là ce soir.

etapes.en: Imagine a world where everyone speaks at least two languages.
etapes.fr: Imaginez un monde où tout le monde parle au moins deux langues.

resume: Hook → signposting (firstly, secondly, finally) → strong ending. Rule of three, rhetorical questions, pauses.
devoir: Prepare and record a 2-minute speech on a topic you love.
